req.title: Reject squadNumber lookup for non-numeric value
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when GET /players/squadNumber/{value} receives a non-integer segment.
triggers: reject squadnumber lookup for non-numeric value

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-037 requires HTTP 422 when GET /players/squadNumber/{value} receives a non-integer path segment. The violation was in test[3]: kind=negative but heuristic=EP. EP (Equivalence Partitioning) is valid for negative tests when the input belongs to an invalid equivalence class, BUT the rule-based checker flags negative+EP as a logical conflict. The fix is to change test[3]'s heuristic from EP to NEG, which is the correct heuristic for negative/invalid-input tests. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_get_by_squad_number_valid_integer_returns_200
preconditions: Database contains a player with squadNumber=10
expected: Response body contains squadNumber field equal to 10
trace: R-PLAYER-037 — valid integer segment must NOT be rejected; confirms the 422 path is not triggered for well-formed input
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
assert response.status_code == 200
body = response.json()
assert body['squadNumber'] == 10

tests.name: test_get_by_squad_number_status_code_is_not_200_for_non_integer
actions: Assert status code is exactly 422 and not 200, 404, or 400
expected: HTTP 422 exactly — not 200, not 404, not 400, not 500
trace: R-PLAYER-037 — decision table: non-integer input → 422; tests that the exact error code constant 422 is used, catching mutations to 400, 404, or 200
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/squadnumber/xyz')
assert response.status_code == 422
assert response.status_code != 200
assert response.status_code != 404
assert response.status_code != 400
assert response.status_code != 500
